process_deviations_disclosed: One bounded SMOKE invocation was killed by the AGENT's own tool wall clock (2 min) before bounded_run could write its report -- the F-071 ordering hazard. Cause was a malformed shell fragment in the pytest argument list that made the selection collect the whole repo. The process table was checked immediately afterwards: the Job Object had terminated every child, zero survivors, and the only python.exe processes alive belonged to VS Code's isort LSP and to REV-059's own bounded run, neither of which was touched. The allocated placeholder 02-smoke-tip.json was then REUSED for the corrected run rather than abandoned, so no placeholder is orphaned.
Development-time probes ran through bounded_run without --json, deliberately, so that no G11 placeholder was allocated for a job that was not a gate.
